title: SEMI-FINAL 🔥 UK vs Saudi Arabia vs Algeria… 16 Go to the Grand Final | Country Marble Race Heat 1/2
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1, Semi-Final · Heat 1/2: 24 countries race through 2 stages — only 16 survive and go to The Grand Final.

Countries in this heat: Algeria, Andorra, Bhutan, El Salvador, Ghana, Guinea, Ireland, Kenya, Kuwait, Latvia, Lebanon, Libya, Micronesia, Namibia, North Macedonia, Papua New Guinea, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saudi Arabia, Tonga, Uganda, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, Venezuela, Zimbabwe.

Countries still in the game before this race: 48 of 193.
Next race: Semi-Final · Heat 2/2. Grand Final: Nov 8.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. New races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
